content: Cefuroxime axetil is available in tablet form under the brand name Ceftin®. The 250 mg tablets are packaged in quantities of 20 and are labeled with the National Drug Code (NDC) 0173-0387-00. The 500 mg tablets are also packaged in quantities of 20 and are labeled with the NDC 0173-0394-00. Each 500 mg tablet contains cefuroxime axetil equivalent to 500 mg of cefuroxime. These medications are prescription-only (Rx only). Dosage and administration instructions are provided in the package insert. The tablets should be stored at a temperature between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F). After each use, the cap should be securely replaced. These products are manufactured by GlaxoSmithKline in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, USA, and are made in England. Cefuroxime axetil is also available as an oral suspension. The suspension, when constituted, contains 125 mg or 250 mg of cefuroxime per 5 mL (1 teaspoonful). Directions for mixing the oral suspension are as follows: 1. Prepare the suspension at the time of dispensing. 2. Shake the bottle to loosen the powder. 3. Remove the cap. 4. Add the specified amount of water for reconstitution (37 mL for one formulation, 19 mL for another). 5. Replace the cap and invert the bottle. 6. Vigorously rock the bottle from side to side to allow the water to mix with the powder. 7. Once the sound of the powder against the bottle disappears, turn the bottle upright and shake it vigorously in a diagonal direction. Before reconstitution, the dry powder should be stored at a temperature between 2°C and 30°C (36°F and 86°F). After reconstitution, the suspension should be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C (36°F and 46°F). The suspension must be shaken well before each use, and the cap should be securely replaced after each opening. The reconstituted suspension should be discarded after 10 days. These products are also manufactured by GlaxoSmithKline in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, USA, and are made in England.
